test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Red is sitting fourth to the right of White. Blue is sitting second to the right of Gray. Black is sitting third to the right of Pink. White is the immediate neighbour of Gray and Black.. Who is the immediate neighbour of Red and Pink?
solution: Given: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Red is sitting fourth to the right of White. 2) White is the immediate neighbour of Gray and Black. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2c8f6a4110d016f3e24d7a8f70e7747061fac4c3d2bddbfccd6a5faf771d05b.png] 3) Blue is sitting second to the right of Gray. Here case 2 gets eliminated.
